title: Multiple blasts and fire reported at Dubai's Jebel Ali port
summary: Multiple explosions and a large fire occurred at Dubai's Jebel Ali industrial area, according to reports. The blasts reportedly took place at the Jebel Ali port. Details regarding the cause, any casualties, or specific damage were not provided in the coverage.
summary_points: Multiple blasts and a large fire were reported at Dubai's Jebel Ali industrial area.
The blasts reportedly occurred at the Jebel Ali port.
The coverage did not specify the cause of the blasts or fire.
No information on casualties or specific damage was included in the reports.
title_hi: दुबई के जेबेल अली बंदरगाह पर कई विस्फोट और आग लगने की सूचना

summary_points_hi: दुबई के जेबेल अली औद्योगिक क्षेत्र में कई विस्फोटों और एक बड़ी आग लगने की सूचना मिली।
